set.body: Profile the d3e96fdf automatic public path on development-only image pairs and explain why half of ordinary same-subject rows enter approximately 3 s structural capture. Produce a narrow deterministic optimization that preserves the fixed identity-adequacy objective, candidate ordering, failure evidence, single-thread semantics, and zero nonlinear setup. Do not tune against the exposed L28 court. Validate capture decisions and transforms on independent development fixtures, JVM and Scala.js parity, allocation/work counters, and complete output cost. Then freeze a new unopened accuracy and cost court for the changed candidate. GL remains withheld until the new candidate passes accuracy and the intended ordinary automatic-path latency targets.
set.title: FA-L31: Reduce automatic structural-capture tail without weakening accuracy
